notes: Four localized manipulation episodes are visible. The two driver-door cycles are separated by a complete closure and substantial repositioning, so they are counted independently. General camera circling is excluded.
scene_description: A user circles a stationary blue Toyota Supra in an outdoor parking lot, twice opens and closes the driver-side door, then opens and closes the front hood, and finally opens and closes the rear liftback hatch.
